blocks.text: In this chapter, we will study homeostasis. We will explore the mechanisms of thermoregulation and osmoregulation and examine the importance of maintaining homeostasis for the health and survival of human beings.

Homeostasis is a vital process by which living organisms maintain a stable internal environment, despite changes in their external environment. Homeostasis consists of a wide range of mechanisms that work together to regulate the body's internal environment. Important processes of homeostasis are thermoregulation, osmoregulation, and excretion.
